items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: let's see who was that was it Blanche Thomas or Jeanette Kimball Jeanette Kimball played the piano and I think I had the impression she ran the band but I could be wrong

ctx.x: and hired Celestan and got his band in there and Celestan had another band oh so Celestan really didn't have two bands well one at the paddock was yeah that was they were using his name but

wasn't really his band of Freeco's band yeah well I remember I remember enjoying going to the paddock in the late 40s early 50s well didn't you photograph Celestan somewhere else I don't know if I don't think I photographed him you heard him other places I heard him I'm trying to remember whether he was I don't think he was I don't think he played with the other band I think the band was there but I don't think he was with it you mean you saw his other bands yeah yeah at a fraternity party yeah but I don't think…
